use_cases: Display social media brand icons in an eye-catching infinite scrolling marquee
Showcase partner or client logos on a website footer or about section
Add animated brand presence to hero sections or landing pages
Create a continuous brand awareness loop with clickable social links
Enhance portfolio or showcase pages with animated branding elements
ai_summary: An infinite scrolling brand showcase component featuring social media icons (X/Twitter) in a continuous marquee animation. Built with Tailwind CSS using CSS keyframes for smooth horizontal scrolling, with mask-image gradient for elegant edge fades. The component includes clickable links and responsive design, making it suitable for displaying brand partnerships, social presence, or client logos on websites.
